name: Flex Sensor (Bend Detection Sensor)
shortDescription: Resistance changes as it bends; ideal for data gloves and robotics.
description: A thin flex sensor whose resistance rises as it is bent, letting projects detect finger movement or flexing. Popular for data gloves, robotic hands and interactive wearables.

specifications.label: Length
specifications.value: 2.2 in (confirm; a 4.5 in version also exists)

specifications.label: Use
specifications.value: Voltage divider with Arduino analog input
